reason: We have always washed by hand at the tap, and it costs nothing but our time. With a wedding to save for, I will not spend twenty-two thousand on a machine we have never needed, and the EMI is still two thousand every month for a year.
objection: I have never heard of this brand, and a battery inside a washing machine sounds like one more thing that breaks. If it fails after the warranty, who fixes it and at what cost?
would_change_my_mind: If a neighbour in my village bought it and it worked for a year without trouble, and the price came down to around ten thousand after the wedding is done.
